name: circuit45_chorus
caption: Instrumental polished K-pop and modern electronic game score. No vocals, no singing, no speech. Continuous tight drum groove, punchy bass, memorable recurring hook, polished dynamic arrangement. 136 BPM, E minor. Funky muted guitar chops, clavinet-like synth riffs, punchy electric bass and short brass-synth answers; energetic game-level groove. Large bright chorus, continue the same hook and bass groove, continuous pulse; no ending or fade.
